name: Santovenia de Pisuerga (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a blue wavy band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged with a red lion in each white triangle.
history: The municipal arms and flag were officially approved on 2 October 1998; the flag is square, of proportions 1:1, formed of a white cloth with a blue wavy stripe from the lower hoist corner to the upper fly corner, with a red lion in each of the white triangles.

features.role: wavy band from the lower hoist corner to the upper fly corner
lions rampant in the upper hoist and lower fly triangles
